skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Define and explain basic concepts about single variable functions, limits, continuity, derivatives, and extrema.
Explain and interpret basic concepts about indefinite integration, definite integration, integration methods, and improper integrals.
Describe and explain basic concepts about two-variable functions, partial derivatives, and extrema.

List and describe basic economic concepts such as supply function, demand function, cost function, revenue function, profit function, marginal analysis, price elasticity of demand, consumer surplus, and producer surplus.

Solve basic calculus problems involving finding limits, derivatives (of explicit and implicit functions), approximating changes using derivatives, calculating related rates, determining intervals of increase/decrease and extrema of single variable functions, determining concavity and inflection points of single variable functions, and writing Taylor expansions of functions up to a given power.
Use integration techniques to solve basic integral forms, approximate integrals, and examine the convergence of improper integrals.

Calculate partial derivatives of two-variable and three-variable functions using definitions and rules, solve unconstrained and constrained extremum problems for multi-variable functions (focusing on two-variable and three-variable functions).

Apply knowledge of limits, derivatives, and extrema of single variable functions to establish models and solve applied problems in economics and business such as maximizing profits, maximizing revenues, minimizing costs, etc.
Apply integration knowledge to calculate net change, present value, future value of income streams, producer surplus, and consumer surplus.
Apply basic multi-variable calculus knowledge to solve problems such as maximizing profits, maximizing revenues, minimizing costs, optimal resource allocation, etc.
Apply mathematical methods to solve practical problems in economics, business, science, and technology.
Develop the ability to learn independently, work independently, and work in groups.
Develop personal responsibility and partial responsibility for the group.
